system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Bombadier, Hunter, or Nomad.

Use at the same time as [Timing: Major / Target: Single] and with [Range: 1Sq or higher] attack. The range of attack increases by +2 Sq. and +1D to [Accuracy].

A special ability to aim and shoot prey at a greater distance. Read the wind, see the movement, sharpen your concentration, and shoot through enemies from afar.
